content: {"summary":"Emails were about an hour late on 29 June 2026 due to a slowdown in the email provider (NTF‑E710) that increased send latency.","likely_cause":"External email provider (NTF‑E710) API slowdown causing send latency to rise to ~1.6 s per email, reducing throughput.","confidence":"high","claims":[{"text":"Send latency rose to about 1.6 s per email, dropping throughput to ~25 msg/s.","evidence_ids":["INC-0171#1"],"quote":"During the slowdown a send took about 1.6 s, so throughput fell to 40 / 1.6 = 25 a second"},{"text":"The provider was the slow part; increasing concurrency did not help.","evidence_ids":["INC-0171#2"],"quote":"the provider was the slow part, and pushing more concurrent requests at a degraded API rarely helps."}],"next_checks":["Check provider status logs for NTF‑E710 during the incident window","Monitor per‑email send latency and throughput in real time","Verify if adjusting in‑flight send count mitigates backlog growth"]}
